text:
Penny Lopez: hey everyone! i'm Penny — starting today on Platform. brought a tiny bonsai and a bag of my favorite medium roast. quick q: who wants to adopt the bonsai if it stages a coup? also curious about office coffee culture — chemex person here. :seedling: :coffee:
Ava (People Ops): welcome Penny!!! onboarding schedule sent to your inbox. we do a mug-label rule (someone learned the hard way). also we have a small #plants channel for questions. :tada:
Raj Singh: welcome! kitchen has espresso machine + french press. typically people leave coffee beans in the black bin by the fridge. also +1 to labeling mugs.
Maya Chen: hi Penny — hi bonsai friend :) i'm the office plant steward. tip: keep it near indirect light, mist twice a week, never let it sit in a saucer of water. happy to check on it if you travel.
Penny Lopez: omg thanks Maya, that's so kind. i'll bring a little spray bottle. what size is safe for a desk bonsai?
Maya Chen: something with a fine mist is best, 250-500ml. don't fertilize for the first month while it settles.
Ben Deck: coffee poll time: what are we running? react with one: :coffee: = chemex/pour-over, :espresso: = espresso shots, :tea: = tea only, :palm_tree: = instant granules
Sam (Cafe Crew): labelling tip: Sharpie on the bottom + initial on a sticky dot. also if you want weekly watering drop it on the "plant care" board and volunteers will sign up.
hr-bot: Welcome Penny Lopez! Your welcome packet and badge QR were emailed. If you need any accommodations, DM Ava.
Penny Lopez: thanks all! also i make a small lo-fi playlist if anyone wants calmer background music — happy to add to office playlist. :)
Ava (People Ops): yes please add — we rotate a few playlists each week. ping #general when it's ready.
Raj Singh: welcome again. if the bonsai mutinies i have a tiny pair of tweezers for pruning. :laughing:
Maya Chen: also pro tip: don't put it right under the AC vent. survived one drought last year and our team named it "fernando" :)
Ben Deck: Fernando for president. :raised_hands:
Penny Lopez: new nickname idea: Penny & Fernando takeover. love you all, thanks for the warm welcome!
